howItWorks.heading: How copy trading works
howItWorks.intro: Four steps. Nothing happens to your money without you doing it yourself.

steps.title: Open an account with the broker, in your own name
steps.body: You register directly with the broker. The account, the login, and the money are yours. If you use our link, the broker pays us a commission. That is disclosed right next to the link.

steps.title: Deposit only what you can afford to lose completely
steps.body: You fund your own account, directly with the broker. We never touch it. Leveraged trading can lose more than the deposit, so choose the amount with that in mind.

steps.title: Connect your account to AishCopytrade inside the broker's copy-trading area
steps.body: The broker's platform mirrors AishCopytrade's trades into your account in proportion to the amount you allocate. A 20% performance fee applies to gains only, never to losses.

steps.title: Disconnect at any time
steps.body: You can stop copying whenever you choose, from your own account, without asking us. The account remains in your name throughout, before, during, and after copying.

about.heading: About Aish
about.portraitAlt: Aish at a city window, checking his phone
about.body: I am Aish, a trader from Malaysia in my late twenties. I have been trading for 6 years, mostly gold (XAUUSD), and for most of that time I traded quietly and on my own. Aish Capital exists because I kept being asked the same questions about copy trading, and most of the public answers were either sales pitches or nonsense. So I opened AishCopytrade with {{start}}, put every number on this page, and committed to {{total}} days in the open before promoting anything. I do not hold anyone's money, and I will tell you when I am wrong. One admin helps me run the Telegram group. That is the whole company.

items.q: How do you make money from me?
items.a: Two ways. First, if you open a broker account through our referral link, the broker pays us a commission based on your trading activity. Second, if you copy AishCopytrade, a 20% performance fee is charged on gains the copy makes in your account. Both are disclosed beside every link on this site. Both create a financial incentive for us, and you should weigh that.

items.q: Can I lose more than I deposit?
items.a: Yes, it is possible. With leverage of 1:1000, a fast market move can push an account below zero before the broker closes positions. Some brokers offer negative balance protection; check whether yours does and on what terms. Never trade with money you cannot afford to lose entirely.

items.q: Do you ever hold my money?
items.a: No. Your account is opened in your own name with the broker. Deposits and withdrawals go directly between you and the broker. We never ask you to send money to us. If anyone claiming to be Aish Capital asks you to, it is a scam and you should report it to us on Telegram.

items.q: Why is your track record so short?
items.a: Because it is. AishCopytrade opened on {{openedAt}} with {{start}}. We are running it in public for {{total}} days before promoting results anywhere. Showing you a short, unedited record today is more honest than showing you a long one you cannot check.

items.q: What happens if the strategy loses?
items.a: Your copied account loses too, in proportion to what you allocated. The 20% fee applies to gains only, never to losses, but the losses themselves stay in your account and are yours to carry. Allocate only an amount you can afford to lose, and watch the max drawdown figure on the card above.

items.q: Can I stop copying at any time?
items.a: Yes. You disconnect from AishCopytrade inside your broker's copy-trading area whenever you choose. Open trades are handled according to the broker's rules, usually closed or left for you to manage. Your account stays in your name throughout. You do not need our permission and we cannot stop you.

We use [BROKER]. Read the broker's own terms and our risk disclosure before opening an account. If you open it through our link, the broker pays us a commission based on your trading activity; that is disclosed beside the link and on the affiliate disclosure page.

items.q: Do I need a broker account to join?
items.a: Not for everything. The public analysis channel and the TikTok lives are open to anyone. The community group and the private analysis room require a broker account opened and funded through our link, because the broker's commission is how we are paid. That commission is disclosed beside every link on this site.

howItWorks.heading: How copy trading works
howItWorks.intro: Copy trading means the broker's platform mirrors the trades of one account into another. Here is exactly what that means for you, what it costs, and how it ends.

sections.title: What actually happens
body: AishCopytrade is a normal trading account at the broker. When it opens or closes a trade, the broker's copy-trading system opens or closes the same trade in every account connected to it, scaled to the amount each person allocated.
Nothing is sent to us. Nothing is pooled. Your money never leaves your own account at the broker. We cannot withdraw from it, deposit into it, or log into it.

sections.title: What it costs
body: The broker charges its usual spread and any commission on each trade. If you opened your account through our link, the broker also pays us a share of that. It does not come out of your pocket on top, but it is a reason for us to want you trading, and you should know that.

A 20% performance fee is charged on gains that copying AishCopytrade makes in your account. No fee is charged on losses. The exact fee mechanics are set by the broker's copy-trading system, and you should read its terms before connecting.

sections.title: What can go wrong
body: Copied results are never identical to AishCopytrade's. Your trades fill at slightly different prices, your allocation is different, and the broker may apply minimum trade sizes that change the proportions.

Leverage of 1:1000 means small price moves become large account moves. An account can be wiped out, and can go below zero, faster than you can react. Past results, including AishCopytrade's, tell you nothing reliable about future ones.

sections.title: How it ends
body: You disconnect from AishCopytrade inside your broker account, at any time, without telling us. The broker's rules decide what happens to trades that are open at that moment. Your account stays in your name before, during, and after.
If AishCopytrade is ever closed, all copy connections end with it and your account is untouched.

sections.title: Who we are
body: Aish Capital is an educational and community brand. We are not licensed by the Securities Commission Malaysia or Bank Negara Malaysia, and we do not provide investment advice, portfolio management, or financial planning services. We do not accept, hold, or manage client funds. Trading leveraged products carries a high risk of loss and is not suitable for everyone. You may lose more than your initial deposit. Past performance does not indicate future results.

sections.title: Regulatory status in Malaysia
body: There are effectively no forex brokers licensed to serve retail clients in Malaysia. Most international brokers, including the one we use, appear or may appear on Bank Negara Malaysia's Financial Consumer Alert List and the Securities Commission's Investor Alert List. Regulation those brokers hold in other countries does not give you protection under Malaysian law.
Nothing on this site is an offer, solicitation, or recommendation to buy or sell any financial product. The decision to open a broker account, deposit money, or copy any strategy is yours alone.

sections.title: Leverage and losses beyond your deposit
body: AishCopytrade uses leverage of 1:1000. At that level a price move of 0.1% against a fully leveraged position is enough to lose the entire account. Markets can move that far in seconds, and gaps over weekends or news events can push an account below zero before any position is closed.
Unless your broker offers negative balance protection, and honours it, you can lose more than you deposited and owe the broker the difference. Check your broker's terms before you deposit anything.

sections.title: Copy trading specifically
body: Copied results differ from the source account because of different fill prices, allocation sizes, minimum trade sizes, and timing. Your result can be worse than AishCopytrade's, and can be a loss when AishCopytrade shows a gain.
The figures on this site are self-reported from the broker dashboard. They have not yet been independently verified. A short history, including AishCopytrade's, is not evidence that a strategy works.
You can disconnect from AishCopytrade at any time. Trades open at that moment are handled under the broker's rules, and you should read those rules before connecting.

sections.title: Scams using our name
body: We never ask you to send money to us, to a personal account, or to any wallet. Anyone doing so in our name is committing fraud. Report it to the Telegram admin and to the authorities.

sections.title: Introducing Broker commission
body: Aish Capital operates as an Introducing Broker and receives commission from [BROKER] based on the trading activity of accounts opened through our links. This is paid by the broker and does not increase your trading costs. This commission creates a financial incentive for us, and you should factor that into any decision you make.
The commission is typically calculated on trading volume. That means we earn more when you trade more, regardless of whether you make or lose money. We think you should know that plainly.

sections.title: Performance fee
body: If you copy AishCopytrade, a 20% performance fee is charged on gains the copy makes in your account, through the broker's copy-trading system. No fee is charged on losses. The fee mechanics, including how and when it is calculated, are set by the broker's platform and are described in its terms.

sections.title: Where you will see this
body: This disclosure, in short form, appears beside every broker referral link on this site and in the footer of every page. It is not hidden on this page alone.
We do not accept payment for reviews, articles, or recommendations, and we do not run any other affiliate programmes in Phase 1 of this site.

sections.title: Nature of this site
body: This website is published by Aish Capital for educational and community purposes only. Nothing on it is investment advice, a recommendation, an offer, or a solicitation to buy or sell any financial product, and nothing on it takes account of your personal circumstances.
Aish Capital is not licensed by the Securities Commission Malaysia or Bank Negara Malaysia. We are not a fund, a fund manager, an investment adviser, or a financial planner.

sections.title: Your responsibility
body: Any decision to open a broker account, deposit money, or copy a trading strategy is yours alone, made on your own judgement or with advice from a licensed professional. You should read the risk disclosure and the broker's own terms before doing any of those things.
You are responsible for complying with the laws of the country you live in, including any restrictions on trading with overseas brokers.

sections.title: Accuracy of figures
body: Account figures on this site are copied by hand from the broker dashboard, usually weekly, and are date-stamped. They may be out of date between updates and they have not been independently verified. We make no representation that they are accurate or complete.

sections.title: Commercial relationships
body: We earn Introducing Broker commission and a performance fee as described in the affiliate disclosure. These are disclosed beside every relevant link.

sections.title: Liability
body: To the fullest extent permitted by Malaysian law, Aish Capital and the people who run it accept no liability for any loss arising from the use of this site, the copying of AishCopytrade, or any decision made in reliance on anything published here.

sections.title: Content and changes
body: The text and images on this site belong to Aish Capital unless stated otherwise. You may quote short passages with attribution. We may change these terms at any time; the date at the top shows the current version.
These terms are governed by the laws of Malaysia.

privacy.heading: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy is written to comply with the Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (PDPA). It is short because we collect very little.

sections.title: What we collect
body: If you subscribe to the weekly email, we store your email address, the language you chose, the page you signed up from, the time you signed up, and the time you confirmed. That is the complete list.

We do not collect names, phone numbers, or any financial information. We do not use tracking cookies or marketing pixels. If a pageview counter is enabled, it counts visits without identifying you and without storing anything on your device.

sections.title: Why we collect it and on what basis
body: The email address is used for one purpose: sending the weekly AishCopytrade breakdown. We rely on your consent, which you give by entering your address and then confirming it from the email we send. We do not send anything before you confirm.

sections.title: Who else sees it
body: Your address is stored with Supabase, our database provider, and passed to our email delivery provider to send the weekly email. Neither is permitted to use it for anything else. Your data may be stored on servers outside Malaysia.
We never sell, rent, or share your address with brokers or anyone else.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: Until you unsubscribe. Every email carries a one-click unsubscribe link, and unsubscribing deletes your address from the list. Unconfirmed addresses are deleted after 30 days.

sections.title: Your rights under the PDPA
body: You have the right to access the personal data we hold about you, to correct it, and to withdraw your consent at any time. To exercise any of these rights, unsubscribe using the link in any email or message the Telegram admin. We will respond within 21 days.

glossary.body: Balance is the money in the account with every trade closed. Equity is the balance plus or minus whatever the open trades are showing right now. With no open trades the two are the same.
The change in the account since it opened, as a percentage of the starting amount, as reported by the broker dashboard. Zero means the account is where it began.
The largest fall from a peak to the low that followed it, as a percentage. It says how bad the worst stretch has been so far. It cannot say how bad the next one will be.
